body_text:
If $N\trianglelefteq G$, the set $G/N$ of cosets becomes a group
under $(gN)(hN)=(gh)N$. The identity is $N$ and
$(gN)^{-1}=g^{-1}N$. If $N$ is not normal, the same formula can
depend on the representatives $g$ and $h$ and therefore does not
define a binary operation on the coset set.
